title: Organization for Lab Data using Bash
author: Courtney Comrie
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7h4hj8w
materials: Going into the Data file cd Data/

steps.title: Log onto the HPC or Linux system
steps.instruction: Access the computing environment using the appropriate protocol based on the interface.

substeps.instruction: Use https://dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7ezhjf6 for the HPC web interface.

steps.title: Navigate to the research group directory
steps.instruction: Change the current working directory to the lab's research group folder.

steps.title: Verify current directory and contents
steps.instruction: Confirm your location and list the files in the current directory.

steps.title: Create project and data directories
steps.instruction: Create a new directory for the project and internal folders for organization.

substeps.instruction: Create a new project directory: mkdir EXAMPLE
Enter the project directory: cd EXAMPLE/
Create a project-specific folder: mkdir TEST
Create a raw data folder: mkdir Raw

steps.title: Copy raw data to project directory
steps.instruction: Copy the raw data from the central raw data directory to the project's Raw folder to ensure the original data is preserved.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to the raw data source: cd rsgrps/hutchinsone/Data/Raw
